summary: Listed as a Camden County tower with GFC number 846 on a Georgia tower list; no source describes its build, fate or site today.

notes_for_editor: One list entry (tnlandforms.us) is the only source for this tower; the list's entry carries an unexplained 'datasheet' tag, which the story does not rely on. Neither NHLR nor the former-sites register lists it (absence checked against the full Georgia lists). The Kingsland city history page mentions a 1939 water tower; it is not a lookout and is not used. The easternuslookouts.weebly.com Georgia list has no Kingsland entry. No WebSearch result or source describes the tower's build, staffing, fate or the site today. The brief's status and access stay unknown; no source supports a status, height, design or access level.
